body.statement: Can the attainable Gaussian-tube calibration handle construct \(\widetilde C_N\) with \(\lim_{N\to\infty}\inf_{(P_N,\mathcal S_N)\in\mathcal M}P_N\{\beta\in\widetilde C_N\}=1-\alpha\), a uniformly continuous reference quantile, and a certified approximation from above, simultaneously for \(\lambda_N=0\), bounded local amplitudes, diverging amplitudes, exponent endpoints, and nonconvergent allowed design sequences?
body.justification: This is the nonroutine open step separating conservative honesty from exact least-favorable coverage with attainable critical values.
body.gap: Andrews and Mikusheva establish generic conditional size control, but they do not analyze this curved cone, its diverging-amplitude tangent limits, or certified continuum optimization on changing spatial designs.
body.consumer: A positive answer yields less conservative reported intervals while preserving the uniform guarantee needed for the county-centroid application.
